de_broglie_identity.source: Follows algebraically from ω² = k²c² + ωc² (KK dispersion relation)

mass_cutoff_equivalence.statement: mc²/ℏ = ωc (rest mass = internal dimension cutoff frequency)

de_broglie_wavelength.statement: λ_dB = h/p is the spatial projection of a wave at angle θ = arccos(pc/E) in the full metric field
de_broglie_wavelength.note: Bounce angle θ determined by mass/energy ratio

mass_hierarchy.observation: Round S⁷ spectrum is too evenly spaced for SM mass hierarchy
mass_hierarchy.implication: Internal manifold must be highly anisotropic or topologically complex
mass_hierarchy.consistency: Consistent with non-Killing requirement for chirality

anisotropic_hierarchy.conclusion: Anisotropic internal geometry naturally produces large mass hierarchies

impedance_matching.statement: Conservation laws = orthogonality of internal manifold eigenmodes
impedance_matching.mechanism: Overlap integrals between modes on different internal geometries
impedance_matching.u1_example: Charge conservation = Fourier mode orthogonality on S¹
